author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Current drawing was one big box on stubby legs and read as a projector or camera. Redrawn as the reference's slim tube on a 1:2 tilt: a barrel, a wider objective with a dividing wall, an eyepiece stem with a cap at the back, and three tall tripod legs from a mount under the tube. Reads as a telescope at 48.
omissions: Thin reference eyepiece tube drawn as a stem with a cap.
